questions.q: Data collected first-hand by the researcher through surveys and interviews are called what kind of data? (one word)
Data already compiled by others, like the census, are called what kind of data? (one word)
Which method of primary collection involves asking sampled people questions? (one word)
Name one primary method of data collection besides surveys and interviews. (one word)
The Census of India is an example of which kind of data source? (one word)
Government registers of births and trade are which kind of source? (one word)
How many main classes of data sources are recognised? (number)
If 25 households out of 200 own a car, what per cent is that? (give the per cent)
If 40 of 160 farms are irrigated, what is the percentage share? (give the per cent)
The row labels of a table form the what, while column labels form the caption? (one word)
What are the column headings of a statistical table called? (one word)
What note below a table states where the data came from? (two words)
Arranging collected figures into rows and columns is called what? (one word)
Before tabulation, data must be sorted into what? (one word)
After how many years does the Census of India take place? (number of years)
Which organisation runs periodic rounds of household surveys on consumption and employment? (short form)
Which source gives a complete count of population and houses? (one word)
The NSSO surveys are conducted through periodic what? (one word)
Name one topic the NSSO surveys besides consumption and employment. (two words)
Is the census a sample count or a complete enumeration? (two words)
Both census and NSSO anchor which kind of geographic analysis? (one word)
Which presentation mode gives the most exact figures? (one word)
Which presentation mode best shows a trend through time? (one word)
Which presentation mode best shows spatial distribution? (one word)
Which simple diagrams popularise comparisons among the public? (one word)
The choice of presentation depends on the nature of data and the what intended? (one word)
How many main presentation modes are listed (tables, graphs, diagrams, maps)? (number)
Diagrams and graphs present data to the eye; tables present data to be what? (one word)
